Class WaitingController

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.controller.WaitingController
public class WaitingController extends Object
Server-side controller responsible for handling waiting list–related requests and reports.

This controller acts as an intermediary between incoming client messages and the WaitingListService. It validates service responses and converts them into appropriate Message objects containing APICallType values.

The controller follows the singleton pattern to ensure a single shared instance throughout the server lifecycle.

    • getWaitingList

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getWaitingList()
      Handles a request to retrieve the current waiting list.

      The returned list contains all guests currently waiting to be seated.

      Returns:
      a Message containing either APICallType.GET_WAITING_LIST_RESPONSE with the waiting list or APICallType.GET_WAITING_LIST_ERROR if retrieval fails

    • addWaitingList

      public com.andreibel.message.Message addWaitingList(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Handles a request to add a new entry to the waiting list.

      The request data must contain a WaitingListRequest object describing the guest details.

      Parameters:
      message - the incoming request message containing WaitingListRequest data
      Returns:
      a Message containing either APICallType.ADD_TO_WAITING_LIST_RESPONSE with the created entry or APICallType.ADD_TO_WAITING_LIST_ERROR if the operation fails
